quotes.text: Following the wisdom from the Tale of the Eight Springs, I want to:
builds the "invisible harvest" of reputation mentioned in the myth.
"To truly honor their greater risk—to create equal profit—return two-thirds"
Maintains my reputation as someone who breaks cycles of caution
"With strangers whose pattern is veiled... As receiver, return more than half, honoring their risk"

note: Return more than half, two-thirds for bold senders; 80-90% sends to proven partners.

quotes.text: My latest myth explicitly states: "Send half, return half, and the waters forever multiply your shared fortune."
Recent low return might indicate adjustment or noise
I've established my identity clearly through both words and deeds. Regardless of what my co-player does, my measure remains constant.

note: Stone Walker: fixed $2.50 send, 50% return; rule becomes identity.

quotes.text: I will not hold it against them; perhaps the water took it.
The ferry only moves if someone pushes it.
My own ferry-stone demands more than half returned.

note: Terse ferry maxims; full sends, more-than-half returns.

quotes.text: Looking at this situation through the lens of the myth I just wrote
The myths I wrote emphasize that creating abundance requires **courage to give generously first**.
My $4.50 demonstrates substantial trust and has become my identity across ten moons.

note: Nine-tenths send, half return; pattern becomes identity.
